body.x: iHeadCase is a protective case for the iPhone 4 and 4S with headphones, which are included, concealed by a back cover. It's available in Hardshell and Wallet versions and has recently launched on Kickstarter.com.

Many people who listen to music and watch videos on the move invest in high quality headphones. iHeadCase's innovative headphone storage system protects fragile earbuds and keeps the cable neatly stored away tangle-free, with a fast wind and unwind, allowing people to carry their headphones without them becoming lost, forgotten, damaged or entangled.

The iHeadCase Hardshell is made of light yet durable Polycarbonate. The sleek design and curved back cover add only a couple of millimeters to the width in comparison to a standard leather flip case, whilst providing a more natural grip for the phone. Also the back cover when opened doubles as a stand for landscape handsfree viewing.

The iHeadCase Wallet combines a protective case and a Wallet or Clutch with the Headphone Storage System at the back. It's made of polyurethane, an ethical and animal-friendly faux leather. There's space for three credit cards, one photo ID, a couple of business cards, and some bills. The female Clutch version will also be available with wrist straps and other extra detailing, including some featuring 9 ct gold.

Most of the Kickstarter reward levels come complete with standard Apple-style headphones, interchangeable with most standard models of other headphone brands to accommodate different user preferences. Reward levels start at $25 to pre-order the Hardshell version and $40 for the Wallet, with higher levels offering features exclusively for the Kickstarter campaign.

The Kickstarter iHeadCase is designed for the iPhone 4/4S but versions for other popular smartphones including Blackberry, Samsung, HTC, Nokia and Portable Media Players such as the iPod and iTouch will be launched after the Kickstarter campaign ends.
